name: Pink Princess
summary: Pink Princess is an aesthetic that empathizes girlish innocence, elegance, compassion, and living a life of pleasure and luxury.
description:
Pink Princess is an aesthetic that empathizes girlish innocence, elegance, compassion, and living a life of pleasure and luxury. Although it burrows elements from different time periods, the aesthetic mostly uses imagery inspired by the Rococo era due to Marie Antionette and the era's fashion and lifestyle being used for inspiration. It can be considered as a sub-aesthetic to Princesscore , as they are both visually and thematically similar. However, while Princesscore is about the fantasy of being a royal princess, Pink Princess is more centered around upper-class life.

Visually, the style is very similar to Romantic Academia , although it is not an academic aesthetic. Pink Parisian also has a significant influence on Pink Princess. The color palette is heavy on pink tones combined with gold, white, or other pastel colors. Silver is sometimes used, but is much less common than gold.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Self-love, kindness, compassion, generosity

fashion.Overview: Clothing is ultra-feminine and made in soft fabrics like silk, satin, cotton, cashmere, and high quality wool. It is often embellished with ruffles, bows, and lace. The color black is usually limited to shoes, if worn at all. Although Rococo influence is a huge part of the Pink Princess Aesthetic, in fashion, Marie-Antoinette style outfits are usually only used for costumes and fashion is instead mainly inspired by 20th century vintage looks especially inspired by French It Girl / French Chic fashion except more girly.
fashion.Clothing: Berets; Cashmere sweaters; Bouclé suits, especially in pastels; Floral dresses; Fur hats; Lacy dresses; Pleated skirts; Silk and cotton blouses; Tulle/chiffon/organza skirts/dresses; Lacy socks and stockings; Corset tops; Silk slip dresses; Lacey flared pants
fashion.Pajamas: White cotton or flannel nightgowns with lace; Silk eye masks; Lacey vintage-style lingerie
fashion.Accessories: Charm bracelets; Diamond (or imitation diamond) jewelry; Gold heart shaped lockets; Pink Lady Dior bags and similar girly purses (sometimes with small dogs inside); Pearl jewelry; Silk or satin hair bows; Velvet hair bows; White leather or lace gloves; Pendant or locket necklaces; Tiaras
fashion.Stores: Chanel; Dior; Fifi Chachnil; French Sole; Jennifer Behr; La Perla; Morgan Lane; Natori; Red Valentino; Sissi Shop; Tiffany and Co.; Victoria's Secret; Trashy Lingerie; Flower Knows (especially the Strawberry Cupid and Strawberry Rococo collections)
